notes.title: Version 3.0 - White Hot Edition
notes.content:
* Updated player movement properties. Less floaty. 
* Player can duck. 
* Adjusted collision area for player. 
* Updated difficult sections of several levels to be more forgiving. 
* Can toggle between full screen and windowed mode without restarting the game.
* Change UI color. 
* Spiked block enemies now more colorful. 
* Update audio so long plays of the game won't result in glitchy audio. 
* Fix position of off screen arrow. 
* Pause game if window loses focus.
* Draw collision areas on mini-map.

notes.title: Fourth Early Access Update
notes.content:
Late last night I pushed out another update to VolChaos. Two main things with this update (besides minor cleanup)...

1. Added a deadzone toggle in the options screen. If you're having issues with your controller drifting in one direction all the time, try ramping this up and it will hopefully resolve that. 

2. After you get a high score, just above the normal level summary stuff it will display that score and what your overall rank is. 

Note that it takes a second or two to appear, this is because of the back and forth happening with Steam to save and retrieve the new rankings. 

If nothing appears, then that means you haven't beaten your previous score. 

I don't think there is a lot left to do on VolChaos before moving from Early Access to full release. Thanks for all the comments and suggestions so far. If you've got anymore, please send them quickly. 

- Kris

notes.title: Second Early Access Update Released
notes.content:
Yesterday I released the second update to VolChaos on Early Access. Changes this time include...

[list]
    [*]All expert levels tweaked for difficulty.
    [*]A couple levels that were too difficult to collect all gems were tweaked.
    [*]New level intro graphics for levels that previously repeated old intro graphics.
    [*]Minor UI updates.
[/list] 

I'm gonna look into adding leaderboard support I think so we can all compare our fastest times. I'm not promising I'm adding it, just that I'll be exploring adding it.

notes.title: First Early Access Update Release
notes.content:
Earlier today I pushed out the first update to VolChaos on Steam Early Access. The biggest change with this update is the addition of Steam Achievement! I know a few of you have been asking for that feature and I'm happy VolChaos finally has it. 

This update also included a few level tweaks from levels that were unbalanced / too difficult or just not as fun as they should have been and a few bug fixes. 

The next update will include more tweaked levels, mainly rebalancing all the Expert levels and then addressing any feedback you, the loyal gamer, provide me. Please please please let me know your thoughts and suggestions!
